gates.title: Source checkpoint integrity
gates.operator_action: Verify every entry in AUDITED_SOURCE_RC_MANIFEST.sha256 before consuming external evidence.

gates.title: Authoritative external CI FINAL decision
gates.operator_action: Accept only workflow_dispatch on refs/heads/main with explicit semantic release version and expected repository identity.

gates.title: External CI artifact consumption
gates.operator_action: Verify source fingerprint, CI provenance, package hash and append-only consumption receipt.

gates.title: Production deployment intake authorization
gates.operator_action: Deploy only from the closed-world deployment envelope that passed source/repository/package custody verification.

gates.title: Production post-deploy verification
gates.operator_action: Require real production liveness/readiness/SPA 200, security headers, scheduler evidence and release-check evidence.

gates.title: Production operational acceptance
gates.operator_action: Re-verify deployment and post-deploy evidence before accepting production operation.

gates.title: Self-contained release closure handoff
gates.operator_action: Export only from authorized deployment and accepted production evidence; do not manually assemble the bundle.

gates.title: Independent closure re-verification
gates.operator_action: Run release_closure_handoff.py verify against the exact source checkpoint and expected repository before archival/handoff.
